title: Follow a request
explanation: A browser sends a request to the API. The API reads or writes the database, then returns a response. These constructs illustrate the flow; they are not a live trace.

objects.label: Browser
objects.description: The interface a person interacts with. It sends requests to the API.

objects.label: API
objects.description: The server applies business logic and mediates access to stored data.

objects.label: Database
